world.title: Centre amends Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order: What Indians travelling to or returning from Nepal or Bhutan need to know
world.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) in New Delhi has amended the Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order, 2026. This update introduces specific changes to the previous Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order, 2025. The amendments outline new regulations for Indians traveling to or returning from Nepal or Bhutan, detailing requirements and procedures for smoother travel between these countries.

world.title: Three ways it could affect you
world.summary: The Bank of England has raised interest rates from 3.75% to 4%, marking the first increase in over three years. This change may impact jobs, loans, and savings. Higher interest rates could lead to increased borrowing costs, affecting loan repayments and potentially job security, while also influencing savings interest rates, which may benefit savers in the long term.

world.title: ‘Knives out’: Will Congress impeach Pete Hegseth after GOP midterms loss?
world.summary: Following the Republican Party's unexpected loss in the midterm elections, discussions about impeaching Pete Hegseth have emerged. Democrats can introduce impeachment articles in the House, but they will require support from Republican senators for any action to proceed. The election results have intensified scrutiny over the administration's handling of issues, particularly the US-Israel conflict regarding Iran.

business.title: India to Require State Utilities to Add Energy Storage Capacity
business.summary: India will mandate state-owned utilities to incorporate energy storage capacity to minimize wasted solar and wind energy, according to the power secretary at a New Delhi summit. This initiative aims to enhance the utilization of clean energy amid existing storage capacity challenges. The federal authorities are focusing on reducing curtailed output as part of the country's energy transition strategy.

business.title: LIC Q2 Results: Profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 12,115 crore, NPI grows 16%
business.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) reported a nearly 20% increase in consolidated net profit for Q2, reaching Rs 12,114.78 crore. This growth was attributed to strong premium income and higher investment earnings. Additionally, net premium income (NPI) grew by 16%. The results reflect LIC's robust performance in the insurance sector for the September quarter.

business.title: Mehli Mistry challenges removal as Tata Trusts trustee, seeks independent inquiry into governance
business.summary: Mehli Mistry has challenged his removal as a trustee of the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, citing procedural irregularities and trustee eligibility issues. He is calling for an independent inquiry into the trust's financial administration, alleging conflicts of interest and improper financial benefits received by certain trustees. Mistry's actions aim to address governance concerns within the trust.

technology.title: 1 Leak, 0 Specs [2026]
technology.summary: A Chinese tipster, Digital Chat Station, reported on Weibo that Xiaomi is testing a wide-screen smartphone, described as a non-foldable candybar model with a side fingerprint scanner. The information was shared on November 4, 2026, but no specifications were provided. The claim has attracted attention, indicating potential developments in Xiaomi's smartphone lineup.

technology.title: Google Ads Adds New Telemedicine Certification Option
technology.summary: Google Ads has introduced a new telemedicine certification option from the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) as part of its Healthcare Merchant Accreditation Program. This addition complements existing certification options and is set to take effect in November 2026. The move aims to enhance the credibility and regulatory compliance of telemedicine advertising on the platform.

technology.title: 2026 iPad mini review: Maximizing the mini
technology.summary: The 2026 iPad mini review highlights its enhanced appeal and increased price. Traditionally viewed as a niche product, the iPad mini is recognized for its portability and comfort. However, its smaller screen and limited processing power have constrained its broader market appeal. The latest model aims to maximize its strengths while addressing previous limitations, making it more compelling.

sports.title: Raphinha signs new Barcelona contract until 2030
sports.summary: Raphinha has officially signed a contract extension with FC Barcelona, securing his stay at the club until 2030. The Brazilian winger's new deal reflects the club's commitment to retaining key players as they aim for continued success. Fans are encouraged to engage respectfully with each other and adhere to community guidelines during discussions about the team and its players.

sports.title: Pant set to miss third India A fixture; Bumrah, Jadeja join squad
sports.summary: Rishabh Pant will miss the third India A fixture as he continues to recover from a side strain. His ongoing injury raises concerns about his participation in the upcoming two-Test series against New Zealand. Meanwhile, Jasprit Bumrah and Ravindra Jadeja have joined the India A squad, potentially strengthening the team for the fixture.

sports.title: Ajith Ram's journey from sleepless nights to all-round heights
sports.summary: Ajith Ram, a Tamil Nadu spinner, faced uncertainty following recent rehabilitation for a knee injury. However, his performance this week, which included scoring a century and taking seven wickets in a match, has restored his confidence. As he prepares for the upcoming 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season, Ram's achievements signify a positive turnaround in his cricketing journey.

health.title: New Drug Strategy Could Protect Brain Cells by Blocking Proteins That Inhibit Protective Enzymes
health.summary: Researchers at the University of California, Berkeley, have developed a new drug strategy aimed at protecting brain cells from neurodegenerative diseases. This approach focuses on blocking proteins that inhibit protective enzymes, thereby activating specialized enzymes that can eliminate harmful substances. The findings suggest potential advancements in treating conditions like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's by enhancing brain cell resilience.

health.title: How to take notes that actually help you learn
health.summary: Effective note-taking enhances learning by going beyond mere copying. Experts suggest using techniques like summarizing, organizing information, and integrating visuals to improve retention and understanding. Whether in lectures, meetings, or while reading, structured notes can facilitate better recall. Adopting these strategies helps transform notes into valuable study tools, ultimately supporting deeper comprehension and long-term memory.

health.title: Diabetes Awareness Month: Why diabetes doesn't spare active, lean people? Doctor gives reasons
health.summary: Diabetes Awareness Month highlights that diabetes affects active, lean individuals as well. The ICMR-INDIAB study reports a 24% diabetes prevalence in Kerala. Diabetes is characterized by high blood glucose levels and is a heterogeneous metabolic disorder, indicating it encompasses various issues rather than being a single disease with one cause. Awareness is crucial for prevention and management.

science.title: Mars may not be volcanically dormant after all: Hydrogen chloride discovery raises questions about underground magma and possible life
science.summary: Scientists have detected volcanic gas, specifically hydrogen chloride, above fissures near Alba Mons on Mars. This discovery suggests that the planet may not be volcanically dormant as previously thought, indicating potential geological activity beneath its surface. The findings raise questions about the existence of underground magma and the possibility of life on Mars, highlighting ongoing research in planetary geology.

science.title: Can Hubble be saved? NASA invites companies to service telescope before 2031
science.summary: NASA has issued a request for information (RFI) to private companies to service the Hubble Space Telescope before 2032. The initiative aims to address issues related to atmospheric drag and orbital decay affecting the telescope. The notice, published on October 30, will remain open for responses until November 30, inviting potential solutions for Hubble's maintenance and longevity.

science.title: Antarctic ozone hole becomes 7th largest in history. What's happening?
science.summary: The Antarctic ozone hole has reached its seventh-largest size in 48 years of monitoring, according to measurements from NASA and NOAA. This development raises concerns about the health of Earth's protective ozone layer against harmful solar radiation. Despite this milestone, scientists express optimism regarding recovery efforts and the potential for future improvements in ozone layer conditions.

entertainment.title: In ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’, Yash’s Ravana steals the show
entertainment.summary: In "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend," Yash's portrayal of Ravana emerges as the most compelling character, challenging traditional narratives. The film explores Ravana's struggle for identity, power, and the upliftment of his oppressed clan, presenting a nuanced perspective on his character. This depth contrasts with typical depictions, revealing the complexities beneath the film's grand cinematic presentation.

entertainment.title: Ranbir Kapoor kisses daughter Raha in an adorable BTS pic from 'Ramayana', shared by Alia Bhatt as she showers praise on her husband: 'You poured everything into this one'
entertainment.summary: Ranbir Kapoor's film 'Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend' premiered today, receiving positive reviews. Alia Bhatt expressed her admiration for her husband by sharing behind-the-scenes photos featuring him and their daughter, Raha. She praised Kapoor's dedication to the project, stating, "You poured everything into this one." The film's release has generated significant attention and appreciation from audiences.

entertainment.title: Rs 1 Crore, 24-Carat Gold Finish: How Ramayana Team Built Ravana's Throne In 4 Months
entertainment.summary: The art director of Ramayana, Ramesh, announced that Ravana's throne took four months to create, featuring a striking 24-carat gold finish. The film, released today, has generated significant buzz online, with fans sharing reviews and behind-the-scenes content. This two-part project, costing Rs 4,000 crore, is produced by Namit Malhotra and has attracted considerable attention.
